Thanks, Monica — we will move forward with the merge and banking update. A few items and next steps: 

1) Bank verification: we require either the bank letter provided (acceptable) or a voided check via DocuSign for validation. Evan — please complete the DocuSign bank-verification envelope: https://app.redwood.example/docu-sign/MTZ-8349 . Once signed, AP will update the ledger and attach validation to the vendor file.

2) Historical invoices: AP can reassign invoices up to 36 months without additional manager approval. For anything older, we route to Procurement Director for sign-off. Please flag any invoices older than 36 months in the vendor_merge_request.csv if you want them retained under the legacy id.

3) PO cadence: once bank update is complete, we will create a test PO (net 30) and process payment as normal. Expect the test PO to be issued within 48 hours of bank verification.

I have created the internal change ticket: CHG-2025-0611-HT (AP queue). Monica/AP Ops, please update ticket when merge completes.
